concepts.description: A structural unit representing a component of the AUV system architecture.
A physical or simulated platform representing the robotic body of the AUV.
A defined boundary through which components of the AUV system communicate and exchange data or events.
A component within the AUV module responsible for managing and directing the behaviour of the AUV system.
A basic data type defined within the AUV module to represent fundamental values.
A structured data type defined within the AUV module that groups multiple related values together.
A named data element within a Composite Type that holds a specific value.
A data field defined within an Interface that holds a specific piece of information.
A signal or trigger defined within an Interface that can be raised to invoke a response or action within the AUV system.
A named computational unit defined within the AUV module that takes inputs and returns a value.

instances.description: The module representing the entire AUV system.
The robotic platform of the AUV system, using the Sensors and Actuators interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform to receive sensor data.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform to control actuators.
A controller within AUV_Module that uses the Inputs interface to receive operator commands.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Operator to receive input commands.
A controller for the Last Response Engine within AUV_Module, using the Inputs and Outputs interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by LRE_Ctrl and AUV_Autopilot to send output commands.
A controller within AUV_Module that uses the Outputs interface to autonomously pilot the AUV.
A primitive type representing natural numbers.
A primitive type representing integer numbers.
A primitive type representing string values.
A primitive type representing boolean values.
A primitive type representing real numbers.
A composite type representing a Spherical Vector, containing radial, polar, and azimuth fields of type real.
A field of type real representing the radial component of the SVec composite type.
A field of type real representing the polar component of the SVec composite type.
A field of type real representing the azimuth component of the SVec composite type.
A composite type representing an obstacle, recording its north-south relative distance, east-west relative distance, depth, id, and heading as an SVec.
A field of type real representing the north-south relative distance in the Obstacle composite type.
A field of type real representing the east-west relative distance in the Obstacle composite type.
A field of type real representing the depth in the Obstacle composite type.
A field of type real representing the identifier in the Obstacle composite type.
A field of type SVec representing the heading of the obstacle in the Obstacle composite type.
A value of type SVec representing the heading, defined in the Sensors interface.
A value of type Obstacle representing the detected obstacle, defined in the Sensors interface.
An interface defined by AUV_Module containing input events for task and mode control.
An event defined in the Intpus interface with no parameters and no return value, signalling the end of a task.
An event defined in the Intpus interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting an OCM operation.
An event defined in the Intpus interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting a MOM operation.
An event defined in the Intpus interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting an HCM operation.
An event defined in the Intpus interface with no parameters but with a return value of type real, requesting the current velocity.
An event defined in the Intpus interface with no parameters but with a return value of type real, requesting the current heading.
An event defined in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising the velocity.
An event defined in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising the heading.
A composite type representing a close proximity record, containing horizontal CDA, vertical CDA, and an id of type nat.
A field of type real representing the horizontal closest distance of approach in the Close composite type.
A field of type real representing the vertical closest distance of approach in the Close composite type.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real number.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real number.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the vertical distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real number.
